name: Rod of Absorption

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Absorb
powers.text: When a spell targets only you, a Reaction absorbs it; its level is stored in the rod (up to 50).

powers.name: Draw a spell slot
powers.text: Turn stored spell levels into a spent spell slot of that level (up to level 5) for a spell you cast.

summary: Absorbs spells aimed only at you and stores their levels to power your own spell slots.
text: When a spell targets only you and has no area of effect, you can use your Reaction while holding the rod to swallow it. The spell's effect is negated and the rod keeps its energy (not the spell itself), at a level matching the level at which the spell was cast. Over its whole existence the rod can take in at most 50 levels; after that it absorbs nothing more, and a spell it can't store isn't affected by it. Attuning to the rod tells you its lifetime total of absorbed levels and how many levels it holds right now. A spellcaster holding it can spend stored levels as spell slots to cast prepared spells, but only slots of a level no higher than the slots you already have, and never above level 5; apart from using the rod's levels instead of your own slots, the spell is cast normally. A newly found rod already holds 1d10 levels of energy.
